topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture framework, topics of discussion, and intended learning outcomes on cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic selection and epigenetic drivers in tumor clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how clonal succession operates through Darwinian selection of somatic mutations alongside non-mutational epigenetic alterations that modify cell transcriptional states.

topics.label: Cell of origin and the cancer stem cell model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the cellular hierarchy of cancer by examining tissue stem cell properties and experimental evidence for cancer stem cells across leukemia and colorectal systems.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, inflammation, and stromal dependence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how extrinsic microenvironmental signals, inflammatory responses, and supporting stromal cells promote tumor initiation, progression, and therapeutic vulnerabilities.

topics.label: Methodologies for mapping tumor evolution and microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores experimental, computational, single-cell sequencing, and spatial profiling technologies used to track clonal evolution and cellular interactions within tumors.

topics.label: Integrated multifactorial model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the interplay among mutational burden, cell-of-origin plasticity, and microenvironmental factors in driving malignant outgrowth.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapies.
